verses: Aap keh dijiye! kay mein subha kay rab ki panah mein aata hun
Her uss cheez kay shar say jo uss ney peda ki hai
Aur andheri raat ki tareeki kay shar say jab uss ka andhera phel jaye
Aur girah (laga ker unn) mein phonknay waliyon kay shar say (bhi)
Aur hasad kerney walay ki buraee say bhi jab woh hasad keray
